description:
Create a new custom technician role in ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus named 'L1 Support Analyst'. 

1. Log in to ServiceDesk Plus (Username: administrator, Password: administrator).
2. Navigate to Admin > Roles (under Users or User Administration).
3. Add a new role with the name 'L1 Support Analyst'.
4. Set the Description to: 'Restricted role for Level-1 support staff - request management only'.
5. Configure permissions to enforce Least Privilege:
   - ENABLE: Request module access (View/Add/Edit).
   - DISABLE/UNCHECK: Problem module access.
   - DISABLE/UNCHECK: Change module access.
   - DISABLE/UNCHECK: Project module access.
   - DISABLE/UNCHECK: Setup/Admin access.
6. Save the role.
